key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) reformulates policy mirror descent for terminal-reward LLM generation into a trajectory-level objective that avoids intermediate value estimation while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a critic-free RLVR training recipe for large language models, which can simplify implementation and reduce dependence on state-value critics in reasoning-focused fine-tuning.
method: Uses Bellman equations to rewrite PMD as a trajectory-level objective for autoregressive generation.
Approximates the reformulated objective to derive a practical BPO loss.
Applies a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities as the mismatch-correction weight.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, indicating improved reasoning performance under RLVR-style evaluation.
watch_item: The practical loss relies on an approximation and a smoothed correction weight, so training stability and sensitivity to this approximation may need careful tuning.
